This opens the page with the newest version in your browser. The app never looks for updates on its own.

FITS shows three contact cards, one at a time. Swipe left or right to see the next card. Each card has a QR code, which is a square picture that a phone camera can read. When someone points their camera at the code, their phone offers to save that person as a contact.
The app asks for no permissions on your phone.
The app does not use the internet. It makes the QR codes on the phone, and nothing is sent anywhere.
Scanning a code gives the scanning phone only that person\'s contact card.
The app has no server and keeps no passwords or sign-in details. The only personal details in it are the three work contacts built into the app.
